index: Consumer price index (CPI), all items, Bonaire, 2017 = 100, Statistics Netherlands (CBS), table 84046ENG
note: The Program prices Bonaire (ICP 2021, household consumption only, in US dollars), most of the Caribbean Netherlands' people; its level stands for the three islands, carried by Bonaire's quarterly index (the means are CBS's own annual figures, 103.9 and 126.6). Sint Eustatius' and Saba's own indices are CBS's too, but no level of theirs.
